title: Optimized Origins & Amusing Additions
description: An Origins-Focused Low-Stress Modpack with relatively good compatibility for low-end PCs & Laptops!
body:
This modpack is made **(and currently still being built)** PURELY IN MODRINTH, with minimal config changes that are also **able to be meddled with at your will**!

While being primarily just for me and a group of friends, I am publishing it for _anyone_ to check out. Comments, critiques, and suggestions are **much appreciated** and encouraged, but I _will_ be declining at my will (although hopefully with explanation)!
Message me on discord (av11ra) if needed

_**If any mod developers are not okay with their mods being in my pack, I will remove them as soon as possible.**_


Below I have listed most of the content you are to expect to find as of the initial release;
I love to surf through the modpacks page, but I never fully know what I'm getting into, so for my pack I have provided a list of the "Notable Additions" that you will probably come across when playing.

## SAID NOTABLE ADDITONS INCLUDE:
- Origins (Of Course) (With Expansions / Gimmicks **(CONFIG AT YOUR LIESURE)**)
- Farmer's Delight (Base, Expanded, Nether, End)
- Various [Let's Do] Additions
- Sophisticated Backpacks / Storage
- Essential Mod, Simple Voice Chat, & Lootr
- Artifacts & Accessories / Trinkets
- QOL (Jade, EMI, Dynamic Lights, Treechop/Veinminer, Trash Slot, Inventory Sorting, ETC.)
- Journeymap, Wraith Waystones, Nature's & Explorer's Compass
- Moog's Structures (Nether, End, Soaring, & Voyager) & Structory
- Spectrum & More Geodes
- Hephaestus
- Geophilic (for the overworld), Jaden's Nether Expansion, & Nullscape (for the end)!

_**And More!** (probably...)_
_**(pictures will come as i play the pack personally or if some are submitted via discord)**_
